meshy.prompt_flat: The same car as the reference image, the same dark blue 2018 Bentley Flying Spur V8, the same front three-quarter view from the left side and the same framing, but photographed for 3D texture capture: flat, even, diffuse overcast light from all sides, no studio reflections, no specular highlights or light streaks on the paint, chrome or glass, the windows dark and see-through, the paint colour uniform from roof to sills. Plain light grey seamless background, the whole car in frame, no people, no text, plain license plate.
meshy.why_flat_lit: Meshy 7 bakes the picture's own lighting into the texture: the studio-lit picture gave white streaks on the paint and grey windows; the flat-lit one gives even paint and dark glass, and the page's clear coat adds the highlights. The studio-lit model is kept as meshy_in/bentley_flying_spur_2018_studiolit.glb
